evidence_quotes.agenda: 'What are your biggest concerns on this move?' — asked as literally the first question, before any logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said her biggest worry was 'that you're gonna break it all the furniture... I have some heavy stuff' — the rep followed up meaningfully by asking her to text photos of the two heaviest, most fragile pieces (a glass-topped cabinet and a sideboard) so he could assess handling in real time, a genuine second layer on her stated concern.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Only the generic actual-hours framing landed; no rate-commit line, no explicit pay-less-if-faster line, no self-prep tip, and no 'does that feel fair' check.

top_strength: Excellent discovery-to-action follow-through: turned the customer's stated fear of breakage into a concrete next step (photo review of the fragile items) rather than just a reassurance.
coaching_note: Meet Your Mover and the On-Time Guarantee never got mentioned in this call at all, even though damage coverage (the item most relevant to her stated fear) landed well — worth making sure the full differentiator set gets covered even when one lands especially strong. The call also ends without an explicit close ask; she said she'd decide tomorrow.
